'''Deep patrol''' was the outermost layer of defense around the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fortress [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. It consisted primarily of [[Imperial Patrol Frigate]]s such as the ''[[Bloodprice]]'' commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ors Dogot]]. These were equipped with powerful sensor equipment to enable them to track ships in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and provide advance warning of any attack on Prakith, but they were also expected to locate, attack and capture any [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] warships or enemy freighters that strayed into Prakith territory.
